name: Haraj WhatsApp Auto-Sender (Official Meta Cloud API)

parameters.content:
## 🚀 Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API Automation

**Isolation Notice:** This workflow is completely separate from open-wa. It uses its own tracking key (`sentPhonesMeta`) and official Meta Cloud API endpoints.

### ⚙️ Quick Configuration:
1. Open the **"Meta Credentials & Config"** node below.
2. Paste your **`phoneNumberId`** (from Meta Developer Portal).
3. Paste your **`accessToken`** (Permanent System User Token).
4. Set your approved **`templateName`** (default: `haraj_ad_inquiry`).
5. Make sure `/files/haraj_numbers.xlsx` (or `/files/Test.xlsx`) is mounted in Docker.
6. Click **Execute Workflow** to start sending!
